title: Intentset run records
description: An array of run records (Core §8): one per run of one verification. A record is evidence, not a definition; only a pass at the assessed commit and graph hash is current. Three requirements are beyond this schema and checked by the reader: a timestamp names a real calendar day, finishedAt is not before startedAt, and no two records share an evidenceId. The literal "@current" for commit or graphHash is the conformance fixtures' placeholder for the snapshot under assessment; a driver binds it before classification, and a record still carrying it is never current.

timestamp.description: UTC, ISO 8601, with a Z suffix and an optional fraction of up to nine digits.

verificationId.description: The verification artifact this run executed.

commit.description: The source commit the run executed against.

graphHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical graph (ADR 0005), lowercase hex.

scope.description: The exact product and release the run assessed; release labels match exactly (Core §7).

tool.description: The tool and version that ran an automated check, or null for a review performed by a person alone.

reviewer.description: The reviewer's identity for a manual review, or null for an automated run.

uri.description: Where the run's report lives. Presence is not proof of trustworthy execution (Core §8).

extensions.description: Namespaced keys, preserved and never interpreted.

allOf.description: A manual record identifies its reviewer and the review rationale.
A record without a reviewer is automated and names its tool.
